title: jacobaea chassanica
intro: Jacobaea chassanica, commonly known as the Chassan pyrethrum or Chassan marigold, is a plant species in the daisy family. It has been used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of infections. The therapeutic actions of Jacobaea chassanica include its ability to act as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a potential treatment for various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
